```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

predictors <- c(
  "HomeAway", "TeamRankCategory", "OpponentRankCategory",
  "Round", "OpponentRound", "RestAdvantage",
  "DWF", "DLF", "DDF",
  "attack_score", "defence_score",
  "opp_attack_score", "opp_defence_score",
  "DRF", "DYF", "DFF", "DCS", "DSTF", "DSF"
)

training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

# Same rows for every candidate model
model_data <- training_data %>%
  select(Goals, all_of(predictors)) %>%
  na.omit()

null_model <- glm(Goals ~ 1, data = model_data,
                  family = stats::poisson(link = "log"))

full_model <- glm(reformulate(predictors, response = "Goals"),
                  data = model_data,
                  family = stats::poisson(link = "log"))

scope_list <- list(lower = formula(null_model), upper = formula(full_model))

forward_model  <- step(null_model, scope = scope_list,
                       direction = "forward", trace = 0)
backward_model <- step(full_model, direction = "backward", trace = 0)
both_model     <- step(null_model, scope = scope_list,
                       direction = "both", trace = 0)

formula(forward_model)
formula(backward_model)
formula(both_model)
```
The formulas are all different, use the "both_model" one.
